PSLE-style item (Forces (Friction, Gravity, Elastic, Magnetic)): A 14 kg crate needed 37 N to slide on sandpaper but only 23 N on polished tiles. Explain why more force was needed on sandpaper.

(Include key idea: 'greater frictional force')
